card_evidence.lines_32_34: The authors distinguish end-to-end synthetic SONICS songs from earlier datasets containing synthetic vocals over real instrumental recordings.
card_evidence.lines_108_114: The authors identify Suno/Udio generation and assign target1 to full fake, mostly fake and half fake.
card_evidence.license_scope: Pinned audio dataset card declares cc-by-nc-4.0; the downloaded archive members are the fake_songs audio identified by this card.

paper_category_definitions.evidence_origin: Primary-paper text retrieved earlier in this task before the zero-network retention phase; no local full-paper snapshot was found.
paper_category_definitions.full_fake: Both lyrics and song-style prompts are AI-generated.
paper_category_definitions.mostly_fake: Lyrics are generated using features extracted from real lyrics; song-style prompting is derived from real songs.
paper_category_definitions.half_fake: Lyrics are directly drawn from real songs; song-style prompting is derived from real songs.
paper_category_definitions.interpretation_boundary: These categories describe source inputs and prompting provenance. They are not real/fake audio-segment percentages or timestamp annotations.

label_policy.MUSIC_PRESENT: 1 from source song annotation, subject to decode/finite/duration/energy rejection gates

limitations: No independent per-song listening, no new generator-family claim, no lyrics-rights audit beyond the dataset author license declaration.
Suno/Udio are known generator families; exact hashes do not rule out every cross-corpus re-encoding or unknown semantic reference.
